overview.description: The iShares 1-10 Year U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF (AGGM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks a market-value-weighted index of USD-denominated, investment grade-rated, government and corporate bonds with effective maturities between one and ten years. AGGM was launched on Jan 5, 2007 and is issued by BlackRock.
